sources.name: RouteLLM
sources.intended_use: Compare router framing, strong/weak routing baselines, threshold calibration ideas, and cost-quality evaluation approach.
sources.storage_policy: Do not vendor RouteLLM source or raw generated data into this repository. Use as a cited baseline and optional comparison target.
sources.risk_notes: RouteLLM examples may depend on external model providers. This project must keep runtime routing local-only.

sources.name: LMSYS MT-Bench Human Judgments
sources.intended_use: Convert prompt and human preference judgments into weak-sufficient, strong-needed, or uncertain routing labels.
sources.storage_policy: Store transformed routing labels and minimal prompt snippets only after filtering. Preserve attribution and source URL.
sources.risk_notes: Filter unsafe, personally identifying, or license-sensitive content. Avoid redistributing full model outputs when not necessary.

sources.name: PRM800K
sources.intended_use: Use math/reasoning step correctness metadata to expand exact, numeric, and reasoning difficulty routing labels.
sources.storage_policy: Store derived difficulty and routing labels, not the full original corpus.
sources.risk_notes: Dataset is tied to MATH-style problems. Avoid overfitting router behavior to math-only prompts.

sources.name: CarrotAI ko-instruction-dataset
sources.intended_use: Increase Korean instruction prompt diversity for summary, QA, transformation, code request, and writing tasks.
sources.storage_policy: Use instruction text after PII and unsafe-content filtering. Store source and license in transformed rows.
sources.risk_notes: Recheck dataset card before final submission. Remove samples with personal data or copyrighted long-form content.

sources.name: intfloat/multilingual-e5-small
sources.intended_use: Optional prompt embedding feature extraction for semantic similarity and task clustering.
sources.storage_policy: Do not redistribute model weights. Users download from the public Hugging Face repository when optional embedding features are enabled.
sources.risk_notes: Keep embedding features optional so the router can run without network access or model downloads.
